gloss: to make a comeback; to fight back; to recover

definitions.gloss: to make a comeback; to fight back; to recover lost ground
definitions.explanation: To reverse a losing situation and regain momentum, especially in competitions, business, or struggles.

examples.japanese: ここから{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: We'll make a comeback from here.

examples.japanese: {負|ま}けていたが{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: They were losing but made a comeback.

examples.japanese: 3{点|てん}ビハインドから{見事|みごと}に{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: They made a splendid comeback from being 3 points behind.

examples.japanese: {業績|ぎょうせき}の{悪化|あっか}から{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}すのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to recover from worsening performance.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}で{劣勢|れっせい}だったが、{最後|さいご}の{一週間|いっしゅうかん}で{一気|いっき}に{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}した。
examples.english: They were behind in the election, but made a rapid comeback in the final week.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す → {巻|ま}き{返|かえ}さない (negative)
・{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す → {巻|ま}き{返|かえ}して (te-form)
・{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す → {巻|ま}き{返|かえ}した (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {巻|ま}く (to wind/roll) + {返|かえ}す (to return)

The image is of rolling back something that was rolled against you.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}しを{図|はか}る - to attempt a comeback
・{一気|いっき}に{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す - to make a rapid comeback
・{劣勢|れっせい}を{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}す - to reverse a disadvantage

NOUN FORM:
{巻|ま}き{返|かえ}し (makikaeshi) - comeback, counterattack
